title: Microsoft Teams: building-level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management recommended actions page
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, default, licensing entitlement and documented controls are supported. The shared-device licence naming question needs a minor correction because Microsoft documents its rename to Teams Shared Space in April 2026.

claims.claim: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Recommended Actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.
claims.quote: IT gets new building level insights on the recommended actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: The feature identifies buildings with high Teams Rooms utilisation.
claims.quote: This feature intelligently identifies buildings with high Teams Rooms utilization

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The insights help IT prioritise upgrades of BYOD meeting spaces.
claims.quote: to help IT prioritize upgrades of bring your own device (BYOD) meeting spaces and ensure consistent, high-quality user experiences throughout their office buildings.

claims.claim: The notice says the view highlights buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and remaining BYOD rooms.
claims.quote: Insights will highlight buildings with high MTR usage and remaining BYOD meeting rooms

claims.claim: Microsoft describes the mixed room experience as inconsistent from room to room.
claims.quote: buildings with high Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) utilization that still have bring-your-own-device (BYOD) rooms in them, creating an inconsistent user experience from room to room.

claims.claim: The roadmap, notice and Recommended Actions page state no separate feature price, meter or add-on.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management building level insights recommended actions licensing price meter Shared Space Shared Devices renamed. Read roadmap, MC1257308, /rooms/recommended-actions and /teams-add-on-licensing/teams-shared-device-license; no separate feature charge found.

claims.quote: This feature helps admins maintain smooth operations and plan and budget efficiently.

claims.claim: The page's location hierarchy is sourced from the Places API V1 room resource.
claims.quote: The location hierarchy in the Shared Spaces Insights and Recommended Actions pages are sourced from the Places API (V1) room resource type in Microsoft Graph.

claims.claim: An admin can edit a room's building in Teams Rooms Pro Management portal at Planning > Inventory > room > General.
